posts.title: How I Find Really Good Music
posts.description: Every so often, I find a new favorite song. Oftentimes it’s so good that I have to hold myself back from getting sick of it. I’ve spent a lot of time intentionally searching for these songs because I want to find new music I’ll return to for years to come.
